condition.description:
Condition is the copy's wear — "nm", "lp", "mp", "hp", "dmg" — absent
when nobody has assessed it, which is most holdings. It describes the
copies held rather than the printing, so two entries of one printing can
differ by it.

It never affects a value in these documents: no source hoard reads
publishes a per-condition price, so every copy is valued at the
printing's price whatever its condition.

lang.description:
Lang is Scryfall's language code for the printing ("en", "ja", "zhs"),
absent when hoard has not stored the card's document. Language is part
of a printing's identity — Scryfall mints a distinct id per language —
so this names which of them ScryfallID refers to rather than adding a
dimension to it.

colorIdentity.description:
ColorIdentity is Scryfall's color_identity: WUBRG letters, empty for a
colorless card, absent when the identity is not known to hoard (the
card's document was never fetched, or the emitting query predates it).

Card.description: Card identifies one printing in one finish.

rarity.description: Rarity is Scryfall's: common, uncommon, rare, mythic, special or bonus.

typeLine.description: TypeLine is the printed type line ("Legendary Creature — Elf Druid"), the front face's on a two-faced card.

cmc.description: Cmc is the mana value. Zero is a real value — every land has it — so this is absent only when unknown.

manaCost.description: ManaCost is the printed cost in Scryfall's brace notation ("{2}{W}{U}"), absent for a card with no cost.

oracleText.description: OracleText is the current rules text, newline-separated, with reminder text as Scryfall stores it.

power.description: Power is the creature's, as printed — text because the game prints "*" and "1+*" there.

toughness.description: Toughness is the creature's, as printed, and text for the same reason as power.

loyalty.description: Loyalty is the planeswalker's starting loyalty, as printed.

setName.description: SetName is the set's full name ("Commander 2021"), so a by-set breakdown reads without a code table.

releasedAt.description: ReleasedAt is the set's release date (YYYY-MM-DD), which sorts chronologically where a set code does not.

artist.description: Artist is the illustration's credited artist, as Scryfall spells it.

layout.description: Layout is Scryfall's layout ("normal", "split", "transform", "modal_dfc"), which says how many faces to expect.

flavorText.description: FlavorText is the printed flavor text, absent on a printing with none.

promoTypes.description: PromoTypes are Scryfall's variant tags ("surgefoil", "showcase"), absent on an ordinary printing.

printedName.description: PrintedName is the name in the card's own language and script, absent on an English printing.

tcgplayerId.description: TcgplayerID is TCGplayer's product id for the printing — a marketplace join key, and printing-level, so it does not distinguish finishes.

CardFacts.description: CardFacts is one printing's card characteristics, every one of them derived from the Scryfall document hoard has stored for it.

marketUsd.description: MarketUsd is tcgplayer's sales-derived market price.

Comp.description: Comp is one owned printing's comp sheet: each vendor's USD figure for the owned finish.

source.description:
Source is the provider a container came from — "manual" for a binder,
the site's slug for a deck.

Container.description: Container is one binder or deck, carrying the identity a flat holdings row cannot.

DeckAggregate.description: DeckAggregate rolls every deck into one line, as the report's totals show them; the per-deck split lives in the summary document.

DeckTotals.description: DeckTotals is one deck's totals, ordered by value as the summary lists them.

FiredWatch.description: FiredWatch is one alert: the card, the threshold it crossed, and the price that crossed it.

databaseVersion.description:
DatabaseVersion is the source database's SQLite user_version — hoard's
storage schema, which versions independently of this document's
schemaVersion.

Hoard.description: Hoard is a whole hoard as one interchange document — the payload `hoard merge` moves between two databases.

facts.description:
Facts is what the printing's Scryfall document says the card is —
rarity, type line, mana value, oracle text and the rest — enough to
compute a curve, a rarity breakdown or a text search without fetching
anything. It is absent when hoard has stored no document for the
printing; a field inside it is absent when the card has no such value,
so an artifact carries no power and an English printing no printedName.

A hoard document never carries it: every printing there embeds its
Scryfall document verbatim in printings[].raw, which is strictly more
than this, and adding derived copies would move the content hash `hoard
merge` uses to refuse a source it has already applied.

Holding.description: Holding is a quantity of one card in one container.

Holdings.description: Holdings is every requested holding, one row per printing-finish-container, in the export's canonical order — the same data as the canonical CSV.

comparedPrintings.description:
ComparedPrintings is how many owned printings had two or more vendors,
so a consumer knows how much ground the analysis covered.

comps.description:
Comps is every compared printing's per-vendor sheet, ordered by
valueUsd descending — the data behind the COMPS table.

Market.description: Arbitrage is one pass of vendor disagreement over everything held: the full ranking behind all three tables, not the display's top-N.

since.description:
Since is the comparison cutoff (RFC 3339): each card's newest price
against its last price recorded on or before this instant.

recordedSince.description:
RecordedSince is the oldest price observation held (RFC 3339). When it
is later than Since, history simply does not reach as far back as the
question asked.

Movers.description: Movers is the price changes between two observations, every change rather than the display's top-N, ordered by absolute impact.

marketUsd.description:
MarketUsd is tcgplayer's market price — computed from actual sales —
when the printing has one; every ranking anchors on it.

belowMarket.description: BelowMarket is the fraction the cheapest ask sits under marketUsd.

profitUsd.description:
ProfitUsd is sellUsd − marketUsd per copy: what a buylist pays over
the last-sold price. Positive is genuine arbitrage.

liquidity.description: Liquidity is the fraction of marketUsd a shop will pay.

Opportunity.description: Opportunity is one owned printing-and-finish with the vendor quotes that make it interesting, tagged with the question it answers: "arbitrage" (a shop pays more than the cheapest retail), "liquid" (buylist close to retail), or "spread" (vendors disagree).

source.description:
Source names where the new price came from: "scryfall", or the vendor
behind a fallback.

PriceChange.description: PriceChange is one printing-and-finish whose per-copy price moved.

updatedAt.description:
UpdatedAt is when this row was last refreshed (RFC 3339). A merge keeps
whichever side's row is newer, so a stale database cannot overwrite
fresher prices in the one receiving it.

priceUsd.description:
Prices are per copy in the named finish, absent when no source prices
that finish — absent is not free.

Printing.description: Printing is one row of the card catalog in full, so a hoard receiving this document can accept a card it has never seen without asking Scryfall.

asOf.description:
AsOf is when the prices were observed (RFC 3339); absent when nothing
has ever been priced.

Report.description: Report is the dated valuation: the totals, each binder, the most valuable holdings, and where every price came from.

ReportHolding.description: ReportHolding is one itemized holding: the per-copy price and what the copies are worth together.

SourceCount.description: SourceCount is one price source's coverage: distinct printing-finish combinations and the physical copies they account for.

Summary.description: Summary is the hoard's totals: the loose collection, each deck, and the grand total, as the summary table reports them.

Totals.description: Totals rolls one container group up: how many distinct printings, how many physical copies, and their market value.

Unpriced.description: Unpriced is every holding no source can price — the copies counting as $0.00 in every total.

UnpricedCount.description: UnpricedCount is the residue no source covers, counted the same way as SourceCount.

UnpricedRow.description: UnpricedRow is one unpriced card-and-finish and the containers holding it.

display.description: Display is the name the alert prints, kept as the source hoard wrote it.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the watch was first set (RFC 3339).

Watch.description: Watch is one standing price alert: a threshold on one printing and finish, in one direction.

WatchCheck.description: WatchCheck is one pass over the price watches: how many could be evaluated (an unpriced card answers neither "under" nor "over" and is not counted), and the watches that just crossed into their condition.

description: Document is the envelope every hoard JSON emission shares: a schema version, a kind, and the one payload the kind names.
